description.ja: 建てる場所と順番を選び、村から入り江、見晴らしの丘へ。住民が働き、歩き、休む景色を育てる、小さな3D島づくりゲーム。
description.en: Choose where to build, from a village to a cove and hillside lookout. Grow a little 3D island and watch residents work, wander and rest.

summary.ja: 道をつなぎ、暮らしの景色を育てよう。
summary.en: Connect the paths. Watch island life grow.
